title: Deep clone — recursive (Javascript)
description: Recursively copies plain objects and arrays so mutations of the clone never touch the original. (structuredClone is the built-in shortcut in modern runtimes.)
how_it_works: Lab exercise: type the snippet into a fresh file, run it, and confirm the test outputs match. Then change one input and predict the result before running — Arrays map, objects rebuild key by key, primitives return as-is; nesting resolves bottom-up.

test_cases.note: Determinism check: re-running the snippet reproduces the identical output.

pitfalls: Cycles recurse forever — track seen objects for cyclic graphs.
use_cases: State snapshots, undo buffers, test fixtures.
